jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - WI Market
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is seeking a Senior Project Manager position to support the growing number of projects and initiatives within the Wisconsin Medicaid Market. Reporting to the Associate Director, Project Management, you will provide project management (PM) support for several system modernization projects. You will also provide ongoing support for enterprise and WI Market projects, departmental and vendor related changes and major regulatory changes that require PM oversight. This position will not start until January, 2027.

Main Responsibilities

Oversees projects for the Wisconsin Market Compliance Department with a primary focus on managing internal and external audits.
Designs, communicates, and implements an operational plan for completing projects, monitoring progress and performance against the project plan, and takes action to resolve operational problems and minimize delays.
Identify, develop, and gather the resources to complete the project.
Prepare work specifications, develops project schedules with project staff and external contractors.
Communicate with other operational areas in the organization to secure specialized resources and contributions for the project.
Conduct meetings and prepare reports to communicate the status of the project.
Set priorities, allocate tasks, and coordinate project staff to meet project targets and milestones.
Identifies audit requirements, gathers, and reviews data, and submits requirements to meet audit timelines.
Coordinate communication with external auditors and prepare internal associates for audit interactions.
Review audit findings, coordinates follow-up with auditors, and works with departments to develop and track remediation plans.
Understand contractual requirements, operating systems, department functions, and policies required to conduct business and collaborate with others to support audit requirements.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's degree
5 or more years of project management, business, operational, or technical experience
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
1 or more years of experience leading project management best practices, contributing to PMO standards, and building organizational project management maturity
Must reside within the State of WI or a neighboring state commutable to WI (MN, IA, IL, MI)

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree
Experience working with JiraAlign and Azure Dev Ops (ADO)
8 or more years of project management, business, operational, or technical experience
Experience leading large-scale, enterprise, or market implementation initiatives
Experience in healthcare, managed care, payer operations, or another highly matrixed and regulated environment
Experience mentoring other project managers or contributing to PMO standards, tools, and best practices
Experience presenting information to senior leaders to support and guide decision-making

Additional Information

Workstyle: Home. Home workstyle is defined as remote but will use Humana office space on an as needed basis for collaboration and other face-to-face needs.
Travel: minimal travel to WI may be required
Typical Work days/hours: must be available to work Monday – Friday, 8:00 am – 4:30 pm Central Standard Time (CST).

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.

$86,300 - $118,700 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description Of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

About Us

About Inclusa: Inclusa manages the provision of a person-centered and community-focused approach to long-term care services and support to Family Care members across the state of Wisconsin. As a values-based organization devoted to building vibrant and inclusive communities, Inclusa deploys a unique approach to managed care with a trademarked model of support named Commonunity® which focuses on the belief in everyone, and from that belief, the common good for all is achieved. In 2022, Inclusa was acquired by Humana. This partnership will allow us to create a model of care that provides industry-leading support for members across the health care continuum.

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

jobs.title: Program Manager - APAC (Mobility)
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Reporting to the Head of Program Management – APAC Mobility, the Program Manager is responsible for coordinating and driving the end-to-end delivery of program streams, business initiatives, and key customer implementations across the regional APAC Mobility portfolio.

This role combines hands-on delivery rigor with strong cross-functional coordination, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, milestones are met on schedule, and stakeholder commitments are achieved to support business retention and growth.

Operating across Sales, Product, Marketing, Legal, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Support, the Program Manager translates business needs into structured delivery plans, manages risks and interdependencies proactively, and delivers consistent, transparent communications across all working groups and project sponsors.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery
Manage the day-to-day delivery of multiple concurrent projects and moderate-scale program streams using suitable project methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid frameworks).
Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to clarify scope, milestones, success metrics, and operational deliverables.
Build and maintain integrated project schedules, tracking critical path items, task dependencies, and resource allocations.
Monitor delivery progression against agreed baselines, ensuring execution remains on schedule, within defined scope, and aligned with budget allocations.
Identify, track, and mitigate project risks, issues, and blockers, managing formal change requests when scope or timelines shift.
Prepare and facilitate recurring governance meetings, status checkpoints, and working group reviews.
Coordinate technical and operational workstreams to successfully configure, test, integrate, and deploy customer-facing and internal mobility solutions.
Ensure deliverables satisfy statement of work (SOW) commitments, operational readiness criteria, and customer satisfaction goals.
Stakeholder & Customer Coordination
Establish reliable, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, regional managers, and key external customer leads.
Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for project communications, progress updates, and operational coordination.
Produce clear, structured status reports, project dashboards, and summary decks tailored to project sponsors and steering committees.
Manage expectations transparently, identify delivery bottlenecks early, and escalate blocking issues with clear resolution pathways.
Partner with Sales and Solution Engineering during late-stage deal finalization to ensure smooth handover from pre-sales into delivery execution.
Collaborate with Operations and Customer Support teams to execute structured operational handover and transition to business-as-usual (BAU).
Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
Support continuous improvement of project management toolkits, onboarding templates, delivery playbooks, and tracking standards.
Identify delivery bottlenecks and workflow inefficiencies, recommending practical solutions to enhance operational agility and customer onboarding velocity.
Facilitate post-implementation reviews and retrospectives to document lessons learned and integrate findings into future delivery cycles.
Contribute to building best-in-class delivery standards across the APAC Program Management practice.

Required Skills & Experience

Program & Project Expertise

5–7 years of demonstrable experience managing multi-stakeholder technical or business implementation projects.
Practical working knowledge of modern project methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, hybrid).
Demonstrated capability tracking schedule, scope, resource allocation, and budget tracking.
Solid proficiency in RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) tracking and resolution.
Exposure to AI-enabled platforms or workflow optimization tools is beneficial. Able to recognize the strategic value of AI in driving continuous improvement and performance excellence.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Proven track record coordinating multidisciplinary delivery teams in matrixed organizations.
Customer-centric approach balancing delivery timelines with commercial outcomes.
Strong capability to deconstruct business and functional requirements into actionable work breakdown structures.

Communication & Influence

High-caliber written and oral communication skills suitable for cross-functional alignment.
Ability to influence peers and departmental leads without direct disciplinary authority.
Structured, solutions-oriented demeanor when addressing timeline slippages or operational hurdles.
Confident facilitation skills for sprint ceremonies, steering updates, and kickoff workshops.

Education & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Recognised certification preferred: PMP, PRINCE2 (Practitioner/Foundation), PMI-ACP, CSM, or AgilePM.
Industry experience in SaaS, enterprise software, telecommunications, mobility, or financial services.
Hands-on proficiency with project platforms including Jira, Confluence, Asana, MS Project, Smartsheet, or Monday.com.

Personal Attributes

Strong personal accountability with an ownership-driven approach to delivery milestones.
Detail-oriented, highly organized, and disciplined in follow-through.
Adaptable to evolving priorities, regional timelines, and ambiguous business environments.
Collaborative, team-first mentality committed to customer success and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Deployment Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is being posted on behalf of Ecotrak’s sister company, Entouch

.

Entouch is a leader in smart building and energy management technology, helping multi-site businesses reduce energy usage, optimize operations, and improve building performance. We combine a cloud-based platform with exceptional service to help customers operate smarter, more efficient facilities.

Headquartered in Richardson, TX, Entouch welcomes remote and hybrid candidates for this position. Learn more at www.entouchcontrols.com.

We are seeking a Deployment Project Manager to lead the installation, commissioning, and successful delivery of Entouch energy management systems across commercial facilities nationwide. This role serves as the primary point of coordination between customers, subcontractors, field teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to Entouch quality standards.

This is a highly collaborative, field-focused role ideal for someone with strong HVAC controls knowledge, excellent communication skills, and experience managing multiple deployments simultaneously.

What

You’ll

Do

Project Management & Execution

Lead end-to-end deployment activities for assigned installation projects
Develop project schedules, execution plans, and resource coordination strategies
Manage installation and subcontractor costs to ensure budget alignment
Support subcontractor sourcing, bid reviews, and scope evaluations
Track project progress, risks, and deliverables to ensure successful execution

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary customer contact throughout project execution
Communicate project status, timelines, and key milestones to customers and leadership
Coordinate across internal departments including Operations, Engineering, Solutions Engineering, and Service
Maintain accurate project documentation including schedules, RFIs, change orders, and closeout materials

Installation & Commissioning Oversight

Coordinate equipment startup, commissioning, and system validation activities
Conduct regular site visits to verify installation quality and adherence to scope
Provide technical guidance and scope clarification to installers and subcontractors
Identify and proactively resolve field issues to minimize schedule or cost impacts
Ensure smooth turnover from installation to service and support teams

Scope & Financial Management

Identify, document, and manage change orders and out-of-scope work
Support contract adjustments and customer negotiations as needed
Monitor project financial performance and support cost forecasting activities

Continuous Improvement & Safety

Provide field feedback to Engineering and Product teams to improve product quality and deployment processes
Support training initiatives for internal teams and subcontractors
Promote and uphold all company and site safety standards

What You'll Bring

Experience & Education

3–5 years of project management experience in HVAC controls, building automation systems (BAS), mechanical systems, or related commercial construction environments
Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, HVAC, or a related technical discipline preferred
PMP certification is a plus

Technical Knowledge

Understanding of commercial HVAC systems, controls, and installation practices
Familiarity with BAS/DDC controls and low-voltage electrical systems
Ability to read construction drawings, wiring diagrams, and project specifications

Skills & Attributes

Strong communication and customer relationship management skills
Highly organized with strong attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills
Comfortable working independently in fast-paced field environments
Willingness to travel approximately 10–20% domestically

Work Environment

This role includes occasional travel to commercial job sites across the United States, typically averaging 10–20% travel. Work may be performed in indoor and outdoor environments with occasional exposure to construction-related conditions including noise, dust, temperature fluctuations, and active mechanical or electrical systems. Flexibility for occasional after-hours support, commissioning activities, and limited travel is required.

Why Entouch

Competitive compensation package
Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and 401(k) with company match
Unlimited PTO plus 12 paid holidays
Opportunity to work with innovative HVAC and IoT technologies
High-visibility role with direct impact on customer success
Collaborative, team-oriented culture focused on growth and quality

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who Is American College Of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are a strategic delivery leader who can influence outcomes across the organization and align complex

initiatives to enterprise priorities. You bring a strong balance of execution, excellence, and strategic thinking,

ensuring delivery drives measurable business impact. You are enthusiastic about helping students achieve

their educational goals. You are comfortable operating in both structured and agile environments, applying

the right approach to achieving results. You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are

effective at leading cross-functional teams toward shared goals. You communicate clearly and confidently

with stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership, and bring a strong attention to detail in

managing complex delivery efforts. You are adaptable, pragmatic, and capable of driving accountability while

fostering team effectiveness. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with

others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

As the Senior Project Manager - Agile Delivery, you are responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of

cross-functional initiatives through a combination of strong project management discipline and agile

practices. You ensure successful outcomes by integrating people, process, and technology—while also serving

as a Scrum Master where needed to support team execution, remove blockers, and drive continuous

improvement.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality,

affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $120,000 plus all full-time

employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and

expertise being applied to the role.

What We Look For In The Ideal Candidate

Operates with a high degree of autonomy and accountability across complex initiatives
Proven ability to influence prioritization and trade-off decisions at the leadership level
Strong ability to manage and resolve conflict across cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience driving alignment across competing business priorities.
Ability to translate strategic goals into executable delivery plans.
Demonstrated success improving delivery performance through metrics and process optimization.
Experience driving organizational change and Agile transformation.
Proven ability to align delivery to business strategy and measurable outcomes.
Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate at senior leadership levels.
Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and define structure where none exists.
Ability to lead delivery in high-pressure environments with competing priorities.
Drives collaboration and alignment across cross-functional teams and leadership stakeholders.
Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs. 
Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills. 
Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership. 
Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set. 
Consistently produces a high volume of quality work. 
Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. 
Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel. 
Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.  
Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills. 
Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time critical problems. 
Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail. 
Builds and maintains student satisfaction. 
Recognizes and anticipates student needs. 

Day To Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

Leads the strategic application and evolution of Agile (Scrum and scaled frameworks) across multiple teams to align delivery with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
Leads and coordinates multiple Agile teams and large, complex cross-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment across product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
Defines and enforces project and initiative-level delivery governance, quality standards, and delivery best practices to improve predictability, scalability, and delivery performance.
Drives proactive risk, dependency, and scope management across large projects and strategic
initiatives, escalating and influencing executive stakeholders to resolve competing priorities and ensure delivery success.
Establishes and drives data-driven delivery metrics (velocity, predictability, throughput, outcome based KPIs) to continuously improve team and project delivery performance.
Leads cross-functional teams and influences stakeholders across all levels of the organization, while maintaining accurate project documentation.
Leads executive-level communication, translating complex delivery insights into clear, actionable updates for senior leadership and stakeholders.
Manages project financials, including forecasting, budget tracking, cost management, and ensuring alignment to business outcomes.
Ensures successful delivery and value realization by aligning outcomes to defined business objectives and driving post-implementation reviews and continuous improvement.
Champions and supports Agile maturity initiatives, continuously improving team effectiveness, delivery practices, and adoption of Agile principles.
Mentors Scrum Masters, less-experienced Project Managers, and team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and leadership development.
Owns delivery decision-making across assigned projects and initiatives, balancing scope, timeline, cost, and quality to achieve optimal business outcomes.
Aligns project objectives and delivery plans with organizational priorities while managing competing delivery demands.
Builds strong relationships with executive stakeholders, influencing priorities, resolving conflicts, and driving alignment across initiatives and delivery objectives.
Proactively seeks and confronts risk and issues openly and quickly, while effectively communicating relevant project/practice information to IT management as needed.
Determines new, creative ways to employ teams on projects, distribute responsibilities, share lessons learned, and implement industry best practices.
Identifies opportunities for internal improvement and leads the development and execution of improvement plans.
Accountable for end-to-end delivery and realization of measurable business outcomes, including improvements in operational efficiency, student experience, and system performance.
Leads change management activities associated with assigned projects and initiatives, ensuring successful adoption of new processes, tools, and capabilities.
Partners closely with Product Management and Product Owners to ensure alignment between business priorities, roadmap execution, and delivery capacity.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications And Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or combination of relevant education and experience.
PMP or CSM Certifications or relevant experience.
5+ years serving in a Scrum Master or Agile leadership capacity across multiple teams.
6-8 years of experience in Project Management or related fields.
Demonstrated success leading large initiatives through influence in matrixed organizations without direct authority.
Experience leading large, complex, enterprise-scale projects and strategic initiatives involving multiple cross-functional teams.
Proven ability to lead multiple teams and programs within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Experience presenting to and influencing executive leadership.
Experience with multiple project management techniques, including agile process with SCRUM implementation frameworks.
Thorough understanding of IT service offerings, technical preferences, and technical direction.
Deep expertise in Agile tooling (e.g., Azure DevOps) to enable scalable delivery practices, reporting, and workflow optimization.
Experience managing delivery across highly integrated enterprise ecosystems, including CRM, SIS, and marketing automation platforms.
Ability to Coach and “lead by example” the breakdown of business needs into EPIC, Features and User Stories.
Proven ability to drive decision-making and accountability across multiple stakeholders in ambiguous and evolving environments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with audience in perspective.
Thorough knowledge and understanding of business principles, processes, and technology.
Strong knowledge of Teams, Word, Excel, OneNote, Visio, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
Excellent collaborator able to work with virtual and global cross functional teams.
Experience with systems and business processes to support new product introductions.
Knowledge of multiple existing Scrum Agile frameworks and project management methodology.
Strong analytical, budgetary, and critical thinking skills.
Proven ability to lead multiple teams and complex cross-functional initiatives within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Experience establishing delivery governance, managing project risks and dependencies, and driving
successful outcomes for large, complex initiatives.
Experience with a PPM solution.
Have expert knowledge and ability to identify opportunities for change and the ability to convey the
need for change to IT management.
Experience in high growth small-midsize companies, preferably in Higher Education, strongly preferred.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6

medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a

USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to

Medical, dental, & vision Insurance
HSA and FSA options

401k and employer match

jobs.title: GIS Project Manager (remote)
jobs.description:
About Cloudpoint Geospatial

Cloudpoint Geospatial is a dynamic geospatial solutions provider specializing in Geographic Information Systems for organizations such as local governments, utilities, campus facilities, and public safety. Our mission is to provide location-based tools and services that enable organizations to make informed, data-driven decisions. We improve the lives of the people we serve and create enthusiastic users of geospatial technology, all while maximizing enjoyment in the lives of our team members.

Job Description

Cloudpoint Geospatial is looking for a Project Manager to ensure that projects are completed accurately, on budget, and on time. This position will manage and provide GIS support on a variety of GIS projects for our Local Government and Public Safety teams while working alongside experienced technical GIS professionals. The Project Manager will manage 10 to 20 projects ranging from $15,000 to $125,000 and will follow established procedures to monitor project progress, assign tasks, manage budgets and hours, and identify and report issues to the Vice President of Operations. An ideal candidate will be highly organized, analytical, adaptable, and client-focused, with the ability to manage multiple projects and communicate clearly with both clients and internal teams.

Functions

Manage project resources, schedules, budgets, scope, and hours
Monitor project progress and percent complete to support accurate billing and ensure project profitability
Coordinate tasks and work with technical GIS professionals to keep projects on schedule
Complete GIS-related tasks on their own projects and assist on other projects as needed
Address clients’ ongoing GIS needs and serve as a primary point of contact for project communication
Identify project issues, make appropriate course corrections, and report significant issues to the Vice President of Operations
Manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining thorough project notes and documentation
Communicate regularly with clients and internal teams through email, Trello, Slack, and other project tools
Stay current with changes in Esri technologies and maintain a high-level understanding of GIS concepts
Build strong client relationships and support repeat business through professional, responsive project delivery

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
Experience managing projects and/or working in a project management environment
Experience in completing GIS project work utilizing the latest Esri products
Excellent client-facing and internal written and verbal communication skills
Strong analytical, organizational, planning, judgment, and decision-making skills
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and client-facing teams
Proficiency in basic office applications and the ability to quickly learn new software applications
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, budgets, schedules, and client relationships

Desired Qualifications

Experience working with local government, county government, and/or public safety organizations
PMP certification
GIS certificate or related GIS education

Work Context

Frequent work operating a computer in an office (or home office) setting.
Frequently sedentary with occasional fieldwork requiring walking and lifting 20lbs.
Frequently communicates with coworkers and clients about project work and must be able to clearly exchange accurate information in these situations.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Embedded)
jobs.description:
Silicon Quantum Computing (SQC) is at the forefront of global efforts to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer, while delivering quantum-enhanced AI and simulation products to customers today.

Backed by over 25 years of technological excellence, SQC is a full-stack quantum computing company that leverages its proprietary manufacturing process to engineer atomic qubits in silicon with 0.13 nanometer precision. It is the most precise semiconductor manufacturing in the world, enabling systems with world-leading algorithmic fidelity, and a decisive advantage in the global quantum computing race.

Our products are commercially deployed and generating revenue. Watermelon, our quantum-enhanced AI system, is delivering superior results on real-world problems across energy, telecom and finance. Quantum Twins, our simulation platform, provides unparalleled ability to model quantum systems, accelerating molecule and materials discovery.

This is SQC: building the future of computing while delivering quantum impact today.

About The Role

SQC builds gate-based quantum computers in silicon. Our largest programs are multi-year commitments to US government sponsors, delivered against fixed benchmarks, milestones and independent evaluation. We are hiring a Technical Project Manager (Embedded) into Projects to own the hardware and software delivery schedule for the USQC program.

You will own the detailed schedule end to end for the embedded hardware and software work.You will hold a critical path that runs through fabrication, cryogenic test, firmware and software release, and external partner deliverables. Predictability is the core of the job. You will flag early when a tapeout or release is at risk, and when a test result or blocker lands, you will replan quickly and make the consequences clear to the people who need to act on them.

You will work directly with the hardware and software engineering leads on technical readiness, including test plans, release criteria and the hand-off between design, fabrication and integration. You will also manage the embedded partners and subcontractors whose deliverables feed the tapeout and software schedules.

You will report to the Senior Technical Program Manager. Escalate commercial priorities, scope changes and government requirements to them rather than absorbing them into the embedded plan.

Based at our Sydney facility, you will work across the hardware and software teams, moving between technical detail with engineers, clear synthesis for management, and concise updates for the executive and the CEO. This is a role for someone with a genuine project management mindset: structured, disciplined about following defined processes, personally committed to milestones, and comfortable challenging engineering estimates and pushing back when delivery slips.

Role Responsibilities

Own the schedule for cryogenic and conventional ASIC tapeouts, from design freeze through fabrication, characterisation, and foundry coordination.
Own the delivery schedule for compiler, decoder and real-time control plane software releases, including the release train and the R&D deliverables that depend on them.
Build and maintain a credible critical path across hardware, firmware and software, through fabrication, measurement and subcontractor deliverables.
Flag tapeout, foundry, and release risks early, then drive replanning and communicate schedule, cost, and technical impacts.
Plan and track FPGA hardware development, from requirements through deployment.
Plan and track cryogenic interface and control system development, including coordination with external technology partners.
Define test readiness and release criteria with the hardware and software leads and track them to closure.
Run structured risk assessment for each embedded workstream, with a mitigation plan for every dependency.
Hold engineering teams to their commitments, challenge estimates, and escalate slippage to the Senior Technical Program Manager.
Apply SDLC and quality processes consistently across the embedded teams.
Communicate with engineers in technical detail, and with management in concise summaries.

Your Experience

Experience with embedded systems, including FPGA development.
Experience with software release management or SDLC, ideally on compiler, firmware or FPGA workstreams.
A track record of delivering hardware or embedded programs against fixed external milestones, where the deadline does not move.
Experience owning detailed schedules across hardware and software workstreams, including external partners and subcontractors.
Experience managing external partners or suppliers delivering into a hardware program.
A background in semiconductor, test engineering, embedded systems or hardware program management, where hardware dependencies carry real schedule risk.
A structured approach to risk, identifying dependencies early and maintaining credible mitigation plans.
Experience with Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) across hardware and software teams.
Willing to hold the line, challenging estimates and pushing back when delivery slips.
Strong communication across engineers and management in a matrix environment.
Comfortable operating to defined processes and formal quality requirements.
A fast learner, comfortable picking up quantum and cryogenic vocabulary on the job. Experience on government-funded programs is desirable.

Equal opportunity

SQC is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and encourage applications from candidates who may not meet every listed requirement. If you’re excited about the role and believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply.

Export controls

This position may require access to export-controlled information or technology. Employment may be subject to applicable export control laws and may require eligibility assessment based on factors such as nationality, citizenship, or residency, and, where necessary, obtaining relevant export licenses or approvals.

About SQC

SQC was founded by renowned physicist and materials scientist Michelle Simmons, who pioneered the field of atomic electronics, including the development of the world’s first single-atom transistor and the first integrated circuit built with atomic precision. Our Chair, Simon Segars, former CEO of Arm, is a leader in the semiconductor industry and was instrumental in developing the processors that powered the mobile computing revolution.

As a full-stack company with in-house QPU manufacturing, SQC can design, produce and test new quantum chips in under a week, enabling rapid iteration and a decisive advantage in the race to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer.

SQC is a high-accountability environment built on a simple principle: Every Atom Counts. If you’re looking to play a meaningful role in building the next frontier of computing, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

BAE Systems is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Program Manager to support our Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Futures Division, specifically within the Advanced Capabilities and Integration Branch. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of strategic deterrence by supporting experimental flight testing and payload integration for next-generation technologies and capabilities within the ICBM Systems Directorate.

This Program Manager will be an integral part of a highly skilled team providing programmatic support for the LGM-35A Sentinel and future ICBM development efforts. You will play a critical role in ensuring the successful integration of experimental payloads and the smooth execution of flight test programs.

The candidate will operate in an organizational culture that develops and challenges employees to achieve high performance in a fast-paced, high-morale workplace using streamlined management policies and procedures. It is a challenging and rewarding position with growth opportunity, backed by, and integrated with the broad technology-related capabilities of BAE Systems, Inc. as one of the top 10 DoD contractors. You will provide contributions that will shape the development and deployment of the US Air Force’s next generation ICBM and support similar efforts to integrate aerospace systems engineering, integration, and test capabilities with US Space Force and others within BAE Systems’ broad DoD customer base.

Why BAE Systems? BAE Systems is the third largest defense contractor in the world with an exceptional, mission-focused culture. The BAE Systems employees and sub-contractors located at Hill Air Force Base, Utah are predominantly aligned to the ICBM Systems Directorate, Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center. We support the directorate in sustaining the existing LGM-30 Minuteman III (MM III) weapon system and acquiring its replacement, the Sentinel ICBM. We are a uniquely valued mission partner delivering daily technical excellence and innovative solutions to the Government. BAE Systems has earned accolades as a “Top Workplace” in Utah based on employee feedback for seven consecutive years, earning special distinction for providing a healthy work-life balance for our valued employees. We work very hard to ensure this is a great place to work!

Why Utah? You’ve got to see it to believe it! Utah is an amazing state with diverse geography, an eclectic culture, and an exceptional quality of life. We are located north of Salt Lake City at the foot of the beautiful Wasatch Mountains. The area offers an incredible range of outdoors pursuits across the seasons including hiking, climbing, hunting, fishing, camping, boating and world-class skiing at resorts that hosted the 2002 Winter Olympics, and will do so again in 2032. The state is home to five amazing National Parks and an easy drive from two more; Grand Teton and, famously, the first National Park in the world, Yellowstone. The Salt Lake City area offers a vast array of cultural activities and businesses including multiple professional sports teams. It is a western states hub for exceptional, cutting-edge medical care with people traveling from across the region for a range of nationally renowned specialty care centers and doctors. The Salt Lake International Airport is expanding and offers easy, direct access to just about anywhere you want to fly.

This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing team within a large defense company with an extraordinary, positive culture and mission focus. In this position, you will provide direct support to a national security-critical weapon system through engineering development, deployment, and sustainment activities. You will help shape the quality and performance of engineering and technical products from several hundred personnel supporting the Government, and you will help educate and equip the Government to acquire, operate, and maintain an entire weapon system-of-systems. You will become a trusted mission partner to innovative, digital engineering-driven Air and Space Force organizations that are responsible for designing, building, testing, deploying, and sustaining the world’s safest, most secure, and effective land-based nuclear deterrent and other national security capabilities. Do not miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

Pursuant to Government contract, this position requires US Citizenship status.

The Role

You Will Join a Focused And Dedicated Team Charged With Supporting The Acquisition And Development Of Advanced Capabilities For The ICBM Futures Division. Requirements Management: Supporting the development and management of program requirements, ensuring alignment with mission objectives.
Risk Management: Identifying, assessing, and mitigating program risks to ensure successful execution.

An experienced program manager with a strong interest in aerospace systems and a proven ability to manage complex projects in a fast-paced environment. You must possess high energy and be comfortable working with evolving priorities. The ideal candidate will also demonstrate the following:

Excellent cognitive, communication (both written and spoken), and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts.
A customer-oriented approach, proactively anticipating customer needs and striving to exceed expectations.

A collaborative and team-oriented mindset, prioritizing successful project outcomes over individual recognition.

DOD acquisitions experience

The Senior Program Manager will lead a highly capable, cross‑functional team responsible for the development and delivery of advanced satellite communications solutions. In this role, you will:

Apply earned value management (EVM) and risk management disciplines to effectively plan, monitor, and control program cost, schedule, and performance.
Collaborate with functional and matrixed leadership to ensure timely and appropriate allocation of personnel and resources in support of program execution.
Provide program direction and oversight of subcontractor procurement and performance to ensure alignment with program technical, schedule, and financial objectives.
Build and maintain customer relationships.
Provide accurate, timely program execution, financial status, and risk reporting to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Support capture and business development activities by contributing to business model and capability roadmap development and leading all aspects of proposal development, including strategy, cost estimation, and program execution content.

What You'll Need

A minimum of ten (10) years of progressive professional experience in program management or project management roles of complex technical development programs.
Demonstrated experience in cost, schedule, and performance management using EVM, variance analysis, risk management, and program dashboards.
Experience managing supplier relationships throughout the subcontract management lifecycle, including Statement of Work (SOW) development, performance tracking, and risk/issue escalation.
Experience leading proposal development.
Proven ability to work independently to define and resolve complex problems, anticipate future program needs, and establish meaningful metrics to measure success.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively to diverse stakeholders.
Experienced relationship builder with a demonstrated ability to build and lead cross functional teams.
Ability to mentor, supporting the development of others and the resolution of complex challenges.
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related technical discipline.
US. citizenship and willingness to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.
Travel %: 10%
Must be able to work onsite in our Tempe, AZ or Carlsbad, CA office 3 days a week/hybrid

Active U.S. Government security clearance, with SSBI/SCI eligibility.

You'll take end-to-end ownership of technical customer projects, ensuring they are properly scoped, planned, resourced and commercially controlled before and throughout delivery.

Manage complex technical projects from sales handover and mobilisation through to delivery, customer acceptance, handover and closure.

Support effective resource and capacity planning across Professional Services.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our PSA platform.
Provide clear project and portfolio reporting, highlighting risks, resource constraints, financial exposure and decisions required.
Help continually improve our project processes, governance, reporting and customer handovers.

Our projects encompass a broad variety of technologies and customer requirements, including Microsoft 365 and Azure, cloud and server migrations, networking, firewalls, switching and Wi-Fi, cybersecurity, backup and disaster recovery, telephony, customer onboarding, office moves, hardware refreshes and new-site deployments. We also deliver technology projects within the hospitality sector, including hotel-system upgrades, migrations and integrations.
About you:

You'll already have strong project management experience, ideally gained within an IT Managed Service Provider (MSP) or similarly fast-paced technology environment.
You'll be comfortable managing multiple projects and competing priorities at the same time, but equally willing to get into the detail when a particular project needs your attention.

Proven experience managing customer-facing IT or technology projects.
Experience working within an MSP or fast-moving IT services environment.
Strong customer and stakeholder management skills.
Confidence managing escalations and challenging conversations.
Commercial awareness and experience managing project budgets, hours, margin and scope changes.
A disciplined approach to project planning, risk management, dependencies and governance.
The ability to coordinate technical resources without needing to be the technical expert yourself.
The confidence to challenge incomplete information or unclear scope before delivery begins.
Strong organisation skills and the ability to keep control across multiple concurrent projects.

HCA Healthcare has expanded our influence across the healthcare industry by investing $3.5 billion in capital improvements in recent years. Do you want to be an influencer in healthcare? Apply for our Trauma Program Manager role today!

Job Summary And Qualifications

The Trauma Program Manager works in concert with the Trauma Medical Director and hospital leadership to assure optimal trauma patient care services, quality outcomes, and compliance with local, state, and national standards for Trauma Center designation and verification. The Trauma Program Manager continually strives to achieve successful outcomes for all care and programs associated with the trauma service, serves as operational director for all internal/external program initiatives and hospital, local, state and American College of Surgeons (ACS) requirements. The Trauma Program Manager is closely involved with administrative operations, financial support, clinical services, educational activities, outreach initiatives, and research activities of the Trauma Center.

What you will do in this role:

Manages the operational, personnel, and financial aspects of the Trauma Program, as appropriate. Assist with the budgetary process for the Trauma Program.
Coordinate management across the continuum of trauma care, including the planning and implementation of clinical protocols and practice management guidelines, monitoring of in-hospital patients, and serving as a resource for clinical practice.
Serve as a liaison to hospital administration.
Provide oversight of the Trauma Registry in partnership with the Clinical Data Registry Abstraction Operations Manager. Ensure that the Trauma Registry supports the Trauma PI plan.
Maintain current membership in a national or regional trauma organization. Represent the Trauma Program on various hospital, local, state, and national committees to enhance and foster optimal care management.
Demonstrate outstanding trauma patient advocacy through the use of data and informational findings to develop measurable patient care and injury prevention initiatives.
Act as an agent for the Trauma Medical Director to assure compliance with regional, state, and national trauma statutes and regulations. Advise all departments on regulatory standards and Trauma Center policies and procedures.
Perform administrative functions, include initiating, developing, planning, and evaluating activities of the Trauma Center’s mission of providing optimal trauma care, as defined by the American College of Surgeons Resources for Optimal Care of the Injured Patient.
Maintain all forms of HIPPA and trauma patient confidentiality.
Collaborate with the Trauma Medical Director in the formulation of standards or performance, evaluation, and supervision of the Trauma Center’s clinical support staff.
Demonstrate active involvement in research projects and the analysis and distribution of findings. Facilitate protocol design for accurate data collection, feedback, and analysis as applicable for the facility.
Participate with internal and external disaster management planning. Serve as a member of the hospital disaster management committee.
Stabilize the complex network of the many disciplines that work in concert to provide high-quality care. Serve as an internal resource for staff in all departments and act as an extended liaison for EMS agencies.
Participate in the implementation and evaluation of programs supporting pre-hospital care, transportation, acute hospitalization, and rehabilitation care issues.
Support the Trauma Program through astute accuracy of all reports and timely submission of data to entities which provide funding for trauma care.
Conduct Trauma Department meetings in partnership with the Trauma Medical Director.
Prepare for verification and re-verification as a Trauma Center by maintaining, completing, and organizing supporting documentation such as Trauma Center application(s) and/or PRQ and completing the site verification and designation visits.
Assume responsibility for the development of processes for monitoring and improving the financial performance and resource utilization of the Trauma Center.
Monitor performance improvement activities in conjunction with PI coordinator(s) and Trauma Medical Director.
Ensure trauma patients receive a continuum of optimal care within the context of the American College of Surgeons Resources for Optimal Care of the Injured Patient Guidelines, Joint Commission Standards, and hospital policy and procedures.
Assist with the coordination and implementation of the Trauma Quality Management Plan. Monitors clinical processes, outcomes, and system issues related to the quality of care provided. Develop quality filters, audits, and case reviews to identify trends and events.
Develop event resolution activities to address events with opportunities. Monitor and mitigate for future events.
Coordinate efforts between local and regional trauma systems, supporting optimal quality of care for adults and children within the context of the American College of Surgeons Resources for Optimal Care of the Injured Patient Guidelines, state and regional system regulations, Joint Commission Standards, Trauma Center and hospital Policy and Procedures.
Participate in local, state and national governmental policy development and support the corporate government liaison.
Support marketing, branding, and community informational development for trauma.
Provide professional staff development and direct community trauma education and prevention programs.
Maintain open lines of communication with regional hospital administrators, physicians, nurses and pre-hospital care providers. Provide feedback to referring physicians, nurses, and EMS agencies.
Demonstrate commitment to maintaining market share through patient and consumer education and by improving patient and consumer satisfaction.

The East regional liaison data analyst will coordinate with the University of Kentucky (UK) team, while the West regional liaison data analyst will coordinate with the University of Louisville (UofL) in line with a consistent RMOCC operating model. The data analyst will translate operational data into timely, decision-relevant information for RMOCC leadership and regional partners, working closely with the counterpart analyst to align data practices across regions, identify capacity and patient-flow trends, support dashboards and recurring reports, and improve data quality and usability. The analyst will also support the monitoring, analysis, and reporting of Pulsara utilization and transfer coordination data, helping identify opportunities to improve interfacility communication, patent movement, and regional resource coordination. Pulsara is a secure clinical communication and care coordination platform being implemented across Kentucky to support real-time communication, patient routing, and interfacility coordination among EMS agencies, hospitals, and healthcare partners. Within the RMOCC model, Pulsara will serve as a key enabling technology for regional situational awareness, care coordination, and patient transfer management.

Exceptional analytical mindset and attention to detail. Ability to analyze complex data sets, identify patterns, and draw meaningful conclusions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to create clear and concise reports.
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor junior analysts.
Ability to work in a 24/7 shift-based SOC environment, including covering for teammates and occasional after-hours support.

Demonstrates leadership in handling complex security incidents and coordinating response efforts.
Significant improvement in key performance indicators (e.g., reduction in mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to respond (MTTR), false positive rate).
Successful development and implementation of new detection rules and use cases that improve threat coverage.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst Reshopping - Barcelona or London
jobs.description:
About FCM

FCM is more than a global travel management company with 24/7 support in 100+ countries. We’re a movement, 6,500+ changemakers, travel experts, and performance drivers redefining corporate travel. We don’t just keep the world’s biggest companies moving, we make it smoother, smarter, and bolder. Certified as a great place to work and fuelled by an alternative mindset, we embrace change, challenge convention, and do things differently. This is FCM, where different happens.

About The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Business Analyst to define and answer the right questions that will help us shape and drive our Reshopping program. Reshopping continuously monitors booked hotel reservations and air itineraries and secures better rates and fares on behalf of some of the world's largest corporate travel programs. Scaling it globally means committing to a series of consequential decisions regarding the target market, our customers’ needs, and which parts of the capability we build ourselves versus source from a partner.

Your job is to go and get the understanding and evidence — from our markets, our customers, and the vendor landscape — and to set out what you find clearly. Your findings sit at the centre of every major call we make on Reshopping: which markets, which partners, and what we build ourselves. You will work directly with the Program Leader and Product Managers, and you will be in the room when those decisions are made.

You will report to the Program Leader, Reshopping, and work across both hotel and air.

Location

This role can be based in one of our major offices in Barcelona or London. Fully remote may be considered for the right applicant.

Key Responsibilities

Investigate and document the specifics of our reshopping offering in each of our markets — the operational, regulatory, invoicing, and supplier differences that determine what is possible where.
Research customer and prospect needs across large-market and SME programs, so that what we build reflects demand rather than assumption.
Map the vendor and partner landscape for post-booking cost optimization: what each provider does, where they are strong, and what integrating with them would require.
Map the reshopping value chain — opportunity monitoring, decisioning, servicing, measurement, and invoicing — and set out which parts we rent, buy, partner, or build, balancing flexibility, speed, and commercial and financial benefit, so that the Program Leader and Product Managers have a clear basis to decide on.
Build and maintain the financial KPIs and metrics behind the offering, and identify where the greatest opportunities sit across hotel and air.
Document the commercial and operational lifecycle around the reshopping offering, including manual steps and local variation.
Determine and document system, business, and development dependencies, ensuring a seamless delivery.
Proactively keep abreast of new technologies emerging within the industry, both regionally and globally, and make recommendations on alternate products and options.
Contribute to a safe, inclusive, accessible, and fun work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive.

Experience & Qualifications

5+ years in business analysis, including work where the answer was not known at the outset.
A track record of primary discovery — structured conversations with customers, internal teams, and vendors — and of turning it into something decision-ready.
Proven at evaluating vendors and partners on capability, fit, and integration cost rather than on feature lists.
Grounded in corporate travel or travel technology, including supplier commercial models, post-booking servicing, and managed travel program economics.
Fluent in hotel and air content — negotiated and public rates and fares, rate and fare rules, and cancellation and change conditions.
Strong at building a quantified case from large transactional datasets.
Skilled at defining measurement methodologies that stand up to customer and finance scrutiny.
Able to separate what the evidence supports from what you believe, and to present both clearly.
Comfortable working across many markets and time zones.
Confident writing requirements precise enough for engineers to build from.
Degree in Technology, Business, or a related field preferred.

Your Benefits (Please Note, This Differs By Region)

Enjoy 25 Days Off per year plus 5 Compensation days!
Learn a new language with our free language learning platform.
Employee Retention Share Scheme.
Various social events to promote networking, the celebration of wins, and sometimes just for fun!
Enjoy our discounts with GymApp.
Complimentary coffee, drinks, snacks and fruits at our Barcelona office location.
A strong focus on professional development to support you in the evolution of your career.

jobs.description:
Help shape fair and meaningful customer outcomes at Zip, taking ownership of complex external disputes and driving improvements that make a real difference.
Bring your experience in financial services, compliance or dispute resolution, with knowledge of AFCA or similar external dispute resolution frameworks.
Permanent, Sydney based individual contributor role, collaborating with teams across Risk and Compliance, Customer Service, Credit, Fraud and Product.

Write your story with a career at Zip

Join Zip's Risk and Compliance team, helping our businesses deliver fair customer outcomes while meeting our regulatory and compliance obligations. We're a collaborative team that brings together risk expertise, sound judgement and a Customer First mindset to help the business navigate complex challenges and continuously improve how we work.

As our Compliance Operations Analyst, you'll play an important role in managing external disputes and privacy requests, ensuring customers receive fair, timely and well considered outcomes.

Working with external dispute resolution bodies including the Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) and you'll manage complex matters, build effective stakeholder relationships and help strengthen Zip's approach to dispute resolution.

Beyond resolving individual cases, you'll use complaint insights to identify emerging risks, improve processes and contribute to a proactive, customer focused compliance environment.

What You’ll Own

Manage a portfolio of external dispute resolution complaints from investigation through to resolution, delivering fair, timely outcomes in line with regulatory requirements and relevant dispute resolution frameworks.
Prepare clear, balanced and well structured submissions to external dispute resolution bodies, bringing together evidence, customer circumstances and regulatory considerations.
Manage requests received through Zip's Australian and New Zealand privacy inboxes, ensuring responses are accurate, timely and aligned with applicable privacy obligations.
Coordinate the EDR workflow, including case allocation, escalation of complex matters and monitoring progress to support timely resolution.
Build effective working relationships with external dispute resolution bodies and internal stakeholders, helping resolve sensitive and complex customer matters.
Partner with Customer Service, Credit, Fraud and Product teams to investigate complaints, identify underlying issues and improve customer experiences.
Analyse complaint data to identify trends, systemic issues, emerging risks and control gaps, translating insights into practical recommendations.
Prepare meaningful reporting for risk and compliance governance forums, highlighting key themes, customer impacts and opportunities for improvement.
Contribute to the ongoing development of Zip's EDR framework, strengthening processes, controls and ways of working across products.
Support quality assurance and peer reviews to maintain consistent, high quality dispute handling and regulatory compliance.
Share your knowledge with colleagues and business stakeholders, supporting training and capability development in dispute resolution and complaints management.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and customer outcomes through smarter processes, automation and the thoughtful use of AI and new tools.

What You’ll Bring To The Team

Zipsters work on a broad range of initiatives, and our skills and experiences all look a little different. What really matters to us is that you’re a great fit with our four Values, and have a desire to learn and grow.

So whether you meet some or all of the desirable attributes below, we’d still love to hear from you:

Around 6+ years of experience in compliance, legal, dispute resolution or financial services, with exposure to external dispute resolution processes and regulatory requirements.
Knowledge of AFCA or similar external dispute resolution frameworks, with experience engaging external bodies and managing customer complaints.
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, balanced submissions and explain complex matters in a way that is easy to understand.
Sound judgement and a customer focused approach to managing sensitive disputes, balancing regulatory obligations, fairness and commercial considerations.
Strong analytical and problem solving capabilities, with the ability to identify complaint trends, investigate root causes and recommend practical improvements.
Experience navigating customer service and administrative systems to gather information, review evidence and support thorough investigations.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, fluctuating caseloads and regulatory deadlines.
A collaborative approach to working with stakeholders across different business functions, building trust and contributing to shared outcomes.
A proactive and curious mindset, with an interest in improving dispute resolution processes, controls and customer experiences.
A mindset that embraces AI and new tools to adapt, learn and grow.
An aptitude for identifying and managing risks. Whether you are a People Manager or an Individual Contributor, we are all leaders at Zip, therefore effective risk management is important to how we run our business and part of all our roles.
Our values in your DNA. Customer First, Own It, Stronger Together and Change the Game.

What You’ll Get In Return

As we write this next exciting chapter in our story, we will continue to move at pace and embrace change. For you, this might mean opportunities to learn new skills with hands-on experience, broader responsibilities, or the buzz of seeing your work impact customers faster.

Zip is a place where you’ll get out exactly what you put in. When you join the team, we'll do our best to make sure you can be yourself and surround yourself with smart, friendly colleagues and leaders who have your back, so that you can make the big things happen.

Access the Flare Benefits Hub & Novated Leasing: Save on groceries, fuel, tech, fashion, dining and more, with exclusive health perks, wellbeing guidance and potential tax savings on car ownership.

Be a part of a team that reflects the diversity of our customers

We pride ourselves on being a workplace that provides equal opportunities to people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities, veteran status, and everything else that makes you unique.

Equally, we’re committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive. Please let us know if there are any adjustments that need to be made to ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

Job Description

We are hiring for a Junior Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Intelligence team at Joondalup Health Campus. This is the perfect launchpad to develop your analytical skills, rapidly scale your technical capabilities, and gain hands-on experience driving real business decisions.

Working alongside experienced analysts and stakeholders across the business, you will help transform raw data into meaningful insights, contribute to reporting and visualisation, and support the ongoing improvement of our data and reporting processes.

Communication and collaboration: The ability to explain findings clearly, work effectively with others, and adapt your communication to different audiences.
Initiative and a willingness to learn: A proactive attitude, an openness to feedback, and a desire to develop new technical skills and continuously improve.

Grow your career with recognition programs, employee referral bonuses, scholarships, free access to LinkedIn Learning and the Ramsay Leadership Academy
Save more every day with Ramsay Rewards, giving you exclusive deals at 100+ retailers, restaurants, travel providers and more
Enjoy peace of mind with lower hospital cover costs and higher extras limits on services like General and Major Dental, plus pharmacy and allied health discounts

Australia’s largest private hospital operator, with over 74 sites and 35,000 staff
A values-led workplace where you’ll be supported personally and professionally

CV

jobs.title: Program Manager, Charging Smart (limited term role until July 2027)
Business Analyst / Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
Requirements

3+ years as a BA, Product Analyst or Product Owner in fintech, billing, e-commerce or another domain where money is counted and reconciled.
Ownership Mindset: You bring a recommended option with reasoning, flag what you assumed and what you traded away, and know which decisions are yours and which belong to someone else.
Requirements Writing: Specs with clear scope, acceptance criteria and explicit non-goals - not a list of wishes. User stories, use cases, process modelling.
API Literacy: Comfortable with OpenAPI specs, JSON payloads, REST semantics, webhooks and asynchronous callbacks. You don't write code, but you can reason about idempotency and state transitions.
Data Skills: SQL at a level that lets you check how a rule behaves on real data before writing it into a spec, and read your own metrics after release.
Async System Logic: Understanding that transaction states, retries and reconciliation must be specified rather than assumed.
Rapid Prototyping: Able to put together a clickable or visual prototype quickly - including with AI tools - to agree a flow with the business and hand a designer something concrete rather than a description.
Documentation Tooling: Confluence and Jira - specs, epic decomposition, decision log.
Language: English B1+ (provider documentation, specs and part of the backlog are in English).

Responsibilities

Product work:

Own Features End to End: Take a business need - merchants can't withdraw their own balance, fees are opaque, a region needs a new provider - and drive it to release. Define the outcome, the scope, and what's explicitly out of scope for the first phase.
Scope to a Minimal Complete Scenario: Identify the smallest business flow that works end to end and delivers value - including its provider dependencies, finance dependencies, and the operational procedures that have to exist for it to run in production.
Close Questions, Escalate Risks: Propose a reasoned option rather than a list of alternatives. Document assumptions and trade-offs, resolve questions within agreed authority, and escalate material risks early rather than late.
Prioritise: Argue why this feature before that one, using actual data - transaction volumes, failure rates, support load, provider costs.
Work With Stakeholders: Translate between finance, business development and engineering. Each describes the same problem in a different language.

Analysis Work

Model Money Flows: Specify holds, settlements, refunds, fees and ledger entries. Define what happens on cancel, reject, timeout and provider failure - which balance moves, when, and by how much.
Specify Reconciliation: Define how discrepancies are detected, investigated and corrected - what the system flags, what the operator sees, which adjustments are allowed and who may make them.
Write Specs That Hold Together: Complete rules, no internal contradictions, explicit non-goals. A spec is done when an engineer can build from it without guessing and a tester can verify against it without asking.
Decompose Epics Into a Critical Path: Split a feature into backend, frontend and admin work, mark blocking dependencies, flag external blockers before the team starts.
Define Access and Permissions: Specify role-based access, tenant isolation, and exactly what each actor sees and can do - merchant, finance operator, admin.
Work With Provider Documentation: Read integration docs from payment providers and turn them into requirements the team can build against.

Will Be a Plus

PSP & Acquiring Background: 3DS protocols, chargebacks, settlement reconciliation, provider cascades, routing rules.
Greenfield Experience: Building a product area from scratch, where the process doesn't exist yet and has to be designed alongside the feature.
Regulatory Awareness: PCI DSS, AML, sanctions screening - understanding why certain data can't be logged or exported.
Competitive Analysis: Benchmarking a product against market players and turning gaps into a roadmap.

Format: Full-time

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Remote
